metadata.power_plain_language: At n = 800 (S_A, T3 = half the pooled raw estimate) joint power (OPEN_home R3 & R5 & NOVCHURN_raw R3) = 0.07; at n = 2500 it is 0.26. With T2 (COH1517 raw) it is 0.31 / 0.75. Pessimistic n-mix (S_B, T3): 0.03 / 0.06. The fallback O2r_m30 outcome set is not simulated here (out of scope); analytic n for 0.8 marginal power per index is in n_for_80pct_marginal.
